description:
Create or update a summary for a connected component cluster in the knowledge graph.

A cluster is a group of linked highlights that form a connected component.

IMPORTANT:
- highlight_ids must be the COMPLETE, CURRENT set of highlight UUIDs in the cluster
  (not just newly added ones). The array is sorted internally for matching.
- If a summary already exists for this document_id + highlight_ids combination,
  it will be UPDATED (upsert behavior).
- When updating a stale summary (cluster grew due to new links), pass the FULL
  updated highlight_ids array so the stored record reflects the current cluster.
- The summary should describe thematic connections across ALL highlights in the cluster,
  including any newly added ones.

Typical workflow:
1. Read highlights with highlyt_list_highlights
2. Read links with highlyt_list_highlight_links
3. Compute connected components from links
4. For each component, generate a summary covering all highlights
5. Call this tool with the component's highlight_ids and generated summary

params.description: Parameters for creating or updating a cluster summary.

document_id.description: UUID of the document containing the highlights

highlight_ids.description: Complete list of highlight UUIDs forming the connected component cluster. Must include ALL highlights currently in the cluster, not just new ones. The array is sorted internally for deterministic matching.

summary.description: Summary describing the thematic connections and relationships across ALL highlights in the cluster. Should cover how the highlights relate to each other and their collective significance.

title.description: Short descriptive title for the cluster (e.g., 'Economic Growth Evidence', 'Competing Theories on X')

name: highlyt_upsert_cluster_summary
title: Upsert Cluster Summary
